source_entries.title: PPT 사냥꾼 꿀팁 창고
source_entries.authority_level: discovery_index_only. Any single tip is at most a candidate heuristic, not canonical.
source_entries.publisher_or_account: PPT 사냥꾼 (ppthunter.sos33377.workers.dev), a tips index. The personal or small-operator author is unnamed. The host is a Cloudflare Workers subdomain under the account 'sos33377'.
source_entries.value_statement: Staged generation for token economy: plan → design MD → 1–2 sample slides → full output, instead of a one-shot 10-slide request. | Ask for HTML instead of a .pptx file when you want fast iteration and sharing, and compare trade-offs per item. | Add an image-slot placeholder block to prompts so photos can be swapped in later.
controlled_terms: Index of 13 how-to tip posts with copy-paste prompts and free files or tools. The tone is casual and persuasive ('그냥 복붙해서 쓰세요').
Pro-Claude framing ('압도적 1황이 클로드인 이유')
superlatives and ease claims ('딸깍 한 번', '끝', '100% 무료')
listicle/SEO titles
possible tool promotion (RECOLOR/RESIZE sites)
possible self-promotion of their own tools
this is an index only, so the summaries may overstate what the full posts deliver

Verify the 컴활 reform against an official 대한상공회의소 notice.
Reconcile versions with REF-082.

'100% free' and 'fully editable' claims for Gemini/NotebookLM.
The 컴활 2027 reform details (the 2027-01 AI basics unit and Windows 11 switch) until the official source is verified.

source_entries.title: 오빠두엑셀 회원 자료실 페이지 - 오빠두엑셀
source_entries.authority_level: observational_evidence_of_a_vendor_changelog_only. It is not a standard or canonical.
source_entries.publisher_or_account: 오빠두엑셀 (oppadu.com), the publisher's member resources page. It is a changelog and upload log for templates and add-ins.
source_entries.value_statement: UI-automation and scraping dependencies (messenger apps, shopping search pages, third-party auth) break on upstream changes. Plan for a maintenance cadence. | Guard formulas against edge cases such as 0% progress giving #DIV/0!, single-row array filters giving #VALUE!, and holiday dates breaking an FX lookup. | Version and changelog discipline: dated, semver-like entries per tool.
controlled_terms: A release-note and upload log that signals ongoing product maintenance and member value. It is a self-reported maintenance record.
self-reported changelog, so the fixes are not independently validated
marketing function (shows an active library)
terse entries with no product names attached to version numbers
numbered versions cannot be mapped to specific tools from the excerpt alone

source_entries.title: 500페이지 PPT 색깔, 딸깍 한 방에 바꾸는 법 (VBA 매크로 무료 배포)
source_entries.authority_level: experiment_candidate_requiring_security_and_functional_review. It must not run on production decks and is not canonical.
source_entries.publisher_or_account: PPT 사냥꾼 (same operator as REF-088). It is a tutorial post with an embedded VBA macro.
source_entries.value_statement: Processing order: theme → master → layouts → slides, recursing into groups, tables and SmartArt. | Safety UX: work on a copy, show a confirmation summary, offer a PREVIEW_ONLY dry run, and report a changed-count. | Hue-family mapping with tolerance, partial hue retention, and skipping low-saturation neutrals (MIN_SATURATION).
controlled_terms: Instructional and promotional. It tells readers to paste a macro and run it to recolor a whole deck, and it advertises 'free distribution'. The tone leans on convenience.
convenience framing ('딸깍 한 방')
no license or provenance declared
the text is truncated at ProcessTable, so the full code is not seen
possible funnel to the author's RECOLOR web tool (REF-088 item)
error suppression ('On Error Resume Next') in the code
entities: PPT 사냥꾼 (same operator as REF-088). It is a tutorial post with an embedded VBA macro.
source_entries.version_relation: Same post is listed in the REF-088 index (2026-09-22). It is conceptually the VBA counterpart of the RECOLOR web tool in REF-088. No prior_ref duplicate.
verification_needed: Obtain the full macro text and review it, including a check for network, shell, file or registry access.
Review the implications of the global On Error Resume Next.
Test on a synthetic deck with a before/after diff, covering charts, gradients and theme colors.
Confirm license and provenance with the author.
Confirm that PREVIEW_ONLY is set at compile time and not exposed as an option.
claims_to_exclude: 'Everything changes' (all of background, shape, text, table and chart) without testing.
That undo works (the code itself warns undo may not work and calls StartNewUndoEntry under On Error Resume Next).
That the macro is safe because it is free.
Fidelity on charts, SmartArt and gradients.

source_entries.value_statement: Describe a design system compactly as accent count, base surface, corner radius, button shape and signature layout.
